services.desc: At Skydive Spaceland, we want you to have the best skydiving experience possible! We’re one of the largest skydiving centers in the world with a wide-open, flat airfield and top-of-the-line everything to ensure you have a safe, exciting, comfortable skydiving experience. We’ve been conducting skydiving operations in South Florida for more than 30 great years with the same management. Not all drop zones can deliver the same top-quality experience we can, so we’ve put together a comparison of Skydive Spaceland vs. a typical small drop zone below to help you make the best choice when you select your skydiving center.
